'''Plasteel cylinders''' were storage device made from [[Plasteel/Legends|plasteel]] found across [[the galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] including on the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]], [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], and [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].<ref name="KOTOR" />
